doctrine: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Stop cantik but drift. These rules are the machine-enforceable envelope of PRIMER-1. CI lints every proposal, every page, every generated CSS. A failing rule is a constitutional violation, not a style bug.

red_usage.rule: Red is rationed. Only 4 surfaces may use --red-* tokens.
red_usage.rationale: Maruah is scarce by definition. If red is everywhere it means nothing.

allowed_radii.rule: Radii must be in canonical enumerated set. No ad-hoc values.
allowed_radii.rationale: 12 = tactile midpoint. 2 = orthogonal precision. full = reserved for mission_wheel + trinity_ring only.

max_torus_per_view.rule: Each page renders at most one toroidal anchor (trinity_ring OR mission_wheel OR none).
max_torus_per_view.rationale: Two toruses per page is a design VOID. The torus is the cognitive anchor; two of them is a poster.

allowed_color_families.rule: Only the 5 canonical color families may be used.
allowed_color_families.rationale: Primer colors only. No purple. No gradients of the Google kind. No synthetic neons.

forbid_local_palette.rule: Components/pages must NOT define their own palette. Must inherit from design-tokens.json.
forbid_local_palette.rationale: If a page invents its own palette, drift begins. The Atlas is the only source.

forbid_unregistered_hero.rule: Every page hero must be declared in page-instruments.json. No hand-rolled hero.
forbid_unregistered_hero.rationale: If agents choose heroes, they will make posters. The route registry chooses the hero.

require_channel_field.rule: Every JSON surface in /mcp/ or /surface/ paths must include a 'channel' field matching one of the 5 families.
require_channel_field.rationale: Agent's structural contrast: color = channel. The machine reads canon, not pixels.

require_state_enum.rule: Every interaction state must be one of the enumerated states; never implicit.
require_state_enum.rationale: Tactile state for humans, enum state for agents. Same canon, two renderings.

button_grades.rule: Buttons must be one of 3 grades. No custom button styles.

details.SEAL: solid *-500, ink text, 2px travel shadow in *-700. One per view — the committing action.
details.HOLD: paper fill, 1px *-500 border, dashed on hover. Pending, reversible, draft.
details.VOID: r-500 fill — the only red button. Irreversible. Hold-to-confirm 800ms.

geometry_invariants.rule: Geometry must respect the 4u unit and orthogonal fractal scale.
geometry_invariants.rationale: No arbitrary margins, ever. The grid is the fractal; spacing is doubling.

motion_invariants.rule: Motion is mechanical. 90ms easing, no bounce, 2px travel.
motion_invariants.rationale: Bounce is for toys. This is a console. Honors prefers-reduced-motion.

navigation_law.rule: Navigation is generated from canon/navigation.json. No organ invents its own chrome.
navigation_law.rationale: One nervous system. The trinity nav is the same everywhere. Universal frame.

breadcrumb_url_invariant.rule: Breadcrumb = URL = canon path. If they disagree, sentinel-firable.
breadcrumb_url_invariant.rationale: Breadcrumb is generated from the path, not hand-written. Disagreement = drift.

contrast_rules.rule: Every text/background pair must score >= WCAG AA. AAA for body text.
contrast_rules.rationale: Contrast is constitutional, not taste. CI lint blocks builds where math fails.

fonts.rule: Only IBM Plex superfamily may be referenced in compiled CSS.

maintenance.design-rules.json: Updated when a new rule is ratified. Owner: sovereign (F13).
maintenance.back_compatibility: Additive. New rules enter with version bump. Existing rules cannot be silently weakened.
maintenance.promotion_path: OPEN proposal → sovereign 999_SEAL → version bump → CI lint

tenant_contract.signature: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — Stop cantik but drift. The rules are the law.
